ddl.value: ("status" = 'voided' and "voided_at" is not null and "voided_by_actor_id" is not null) or ("status" <> 'voided' and "voided_at" is null and "voided_by_actor_id" is null)
ddl.name: ballots_voided_fields_check

ddl.value: ("kind" = 'dm' and "title" is null) or ("kind" = 'private_group' and "title" is not null and "title" ~ '[^[:space:]]')
ddl.name: messaging_channels_title

ddl.value: ("removed_at" is null and "text" is not null and "text" ~ '[^[:space:]]') or ("removed_at" is not null and "text" is null)
ddl.name: messaging_messages_content

ddl.value: ("edited_at" is null or "edited_at" >= "created_at") and ("removed_at" is null or "removed_at" >= "created_at")
ddl.name: messaging_messages_times

ddl.value: ("request_state" = 'pending' and "decided_at" is null) or ("request_state" <> 'pending' and "decided_at" is not null and "decided_at" >= "requested_at")
ddl.name: messaging_dm_pairs_request_time

ddl.value: ("state" = 'pending' and "decided_at" is null) or ("state" <> 'pending' and "decided_at" >= "invited_at" and "decided_at" is not null)
ddl.name: messaging_group_invitations_time

ddl.value: "room_id" is null or ("room_config_snapshot" is not null and "visibility" is not null)
ddl.name: rounds_room_freeze_complete

ddl.value: ("status" = 'scheduled' and "current_stage" is null and "outcome" is null and "started_at" is null and "completed_at" is null) or ("status" = 'active' and "current_stage" is not null and "outcome" is null and "started_at" is not null and "completed_at" is null) or ("status" = 'completed' and "current_stage" is null and "outcome" is not null and "started_at" is not null and "completed_at" is not null) or ("status" = 'abandoned' and "current_stage" is null and "outcome" is null and "completed_at" is not null)
ddl.name: rounds_lifecycle_check

ddl.value: ("competition_type" = 'ranked' and "ladder_id" is not null) or ("competition_type" <> 'ranked' and "ladder_id" is null)
ddl.name: rounds_rated_ladder_check

ddl.value:
"ladder_id" = case
          when "competition_type" <> 'ranked' then null
          when "length" = 'full' then 'ranked'
          when "length" = 'quick' then 'quick' end
ddl.name: rounds_ladder_derivation_check

ddl.value: "deleted_at" is null or ("email" is null and "username" is null and "image" is null and "name" = '')
ddl.name: users_tombstone_scrubbed
